title: Return air risers.
officialText:
Where return air risers serve two or more stories and serve any portion of a return air system having a
design capacity greater than 15,000 cfm (7.1 m3/s), smoke detectors shall be installed at each story. Such smoke detectors shall be
located up stream of the connection between the return air riser and any air ducts or plenums.
